name: Tremors of the Earth
summary: At Lethlor, Garek fears the drakes may break free. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. So he sends you to free the drakes and kill them.

sections.title: A Prison Failing
sections.body: At Lethlor, Garek fears Blacklash and Hematus may escape their prison. Black dragons now dwell there, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth. Garek sees no safer course. The drakes must die.

sections.title: Breaking the Seal
sections.body: Three runestones hold the drakes, and the Sign of the Earth is needed to release them. You use the Sign at the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal and Diamond, then place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth. Blacklash and Hematus are freed, and you slay them. Garek asks you to bring back Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.

sections.title: After the Deed
sections.body: After the drakes die, Garek says the Kirin Tor need not fret over Lethlor's prisoners anymore. He plans to report his success to his master, Krasus. Krasus will surely be pleased.

faq.answer: Blacklash and Hematus are drakes held behind a seal at Lethlor.

faq.q: Why must the drakes be killed instead of kept locked away?
faq.answer: Garek can no longer be sure the drakes will stay imprisoned. Black dragons now dwell at Lethlor, and ogres have taken the Sign of the Earth.

aliases: how to open seal of the earth
how to break the drakes out
faq.answer: Use the Sign of the Earth at the Pillars of Amethyst, Opal and Diamond. Then place the three runestones in the Seal of the Earth.

faq.q: What must be brought back to Garek?
faq.answer: Bring Garek Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus and the Sign of the Earth.

aliases: prerequisite for tremors of the earth
faq.answer: It follows an earlier Tremors of the Earth.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, Garek's request is meant for you.
